articles.title: All Five DNA Letters Found in an Asteroid
articles.summary: All five nucleobases, the letters of DNA and RNA, have been found in samples from the asteroid Ryugu.

articles.title: Scientists Remake a Cup That Changes Colour
articles.summary: Scientists have finally recreated the Lycurgus Cup's colour-changing Roman glass.

articles.title: An Old Ape Fossil Found in Egypt
articles.summary: A 17- to 18-million-year-old ape fossil found in Egypt is the first definitive fossil ape from North Africa.
